summary: Full CLI + pytest testing of familylink Termux CLI project. Pytest suite: 29/29 passing. CLI smoke tests: all 12 requested feature behaviors verified end-to-end (init perms, family-head login masking, job create + Google handoff URL, idempotency, invalid birth date rejection, confirm terminal state, simulate-failure transient/permanent, resume refuses permanent-fail, cancel, jobs Rich table, redacted audit, pending-job limit).
critical_code_review_comments: CLI code is well-structured: modules split (cli, service, validation, scheduler, storage, redact, workflow, monitor) each focused and small — no >700 line files.
Redaction is consistently applied in audit output (child/guardian names masked as X***, emails masked as t***@e***.com).
State machine correctly enforces terminal states (re-confirm fails, resume on permanently failed refuses).
File permissions on DB and master.key are set to 600 as required.
Exit codes are correctly non-zero on validation errors, duplicate jobs, terminal-state violations, and pending-limit breaches.
The default supervisor FastAPI/React scaffolding at /app/backend and /app/frontend was correctly ignored per problem statement — all functionality is in /app/familylink.
test_credentials: None — fully local CLI; used FAMILYLINK_HOME=/tmp/fl_test_* for isolation.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test data under /tmp/fl_test_* (isolated per run).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run `cd /app && python -m pytest tests/ -v` for the pytest suite (29 tests) and `bash /app/tests/cli_smoke.sh` for CLI feature regression (22/24 checks pass; the 2 apparent failures are grep false positives on English words 'child'/'guardian' in labels — actual PII is correctly masked as X***). Ignore /app/backend and /app/frontend — they are unused template scaffolding.
